   185	class IdleSleeper:
   186	    """
   187	    In setups which have long inactivity periods it is desirable to reduce
   188	    system power consumption when sglang does nothing. This would lead not only
   189	    to power savings, but also to more CPU thermal headroom when a request
   190	    eventually comes. This is important in cases when multiple GPUs are connected
   191	    as each GPU would otherwise pin one thread at 100% CPU usage.
   192	
   193	    The simplest solution is to use zmq.Poller on all sockets that may receive
   194	    data that needs handling immediately.
   195	    """
   196	
   197	    def __init__(self, sockets):
   198	        self.poller = zmq.Poller()
   199	        for s in sockets:
   200	            self.poller.register(s, zmq.POLLIN)
   201	
   202	    def maybe_sleep(self):
   203	        self.poller.poll(1000)

   185	class IdleSleeper:
   186	    """
   187	    In setups which have long inactivity periods it is desirable to reduce
   188	    system power consumption when sglang does nothing. This would lead not only
   189	    to power savings, but also to more CPU thermal headroom when a request
   190	    eventually comes. This is important in cases when multiple GPUs are connected
   191	    as each GPU would otherwise pin one thread at 100% CPU usage.
   192	
   193	    The simplest solution is to use zmq.Poller on all sockets that may receive
   194	    data that needs handling immediately.
   195	    """
   196	
   197	    def __init__(self, sockets):
   198	        self.poller = zmq.Poller()
   199	        for s in sockets:
   200	            self.poller.register(s, zmq.POLLIN)
   201	
   202	    def maybe_sleep(self):
   203	        self.poller.poll(1000)

   315	        self,
   316	        recv_req: TokenizedEmbeddingReqInput,
   317	    ):
   318	        req = Req(
   319	            recv_req.rid,
   320	            recv_req.input_text,
   321	            recv_req.input_ids,
   322	            recv_req.sampling_params,
   323	            token_type_ids=recv_req.token_type_ids,
   324	        )
   325	        req.tokenizer = self.tokenizer
   326	
   327	        # Handle multimodal inputs
   328	        if recv_req.image_inputs is not None:
   329	            image_inputs = MultimodalInputs.from_dict(recv_req.image_inputs)
   330	            # Expand a single image token into multiple dummy tokens for receiving image embeddings
   331	            req.origin_input_ids = self.pad_input_ids_func(
   332	                req.origin_input_ids, image_inputs
   333	            )
   334	            req.extend_image_inputs(image_inputs)
   335	
   336	            if len(req.origin_input_ids) >= self.max_req_input_len:
   337	                req.set_finish_with_abort(
   338	                    error_msg=(
   339	                        "Multimodal prompt is too long after expanding multimodal tokens. "
   340	                        f"After expanding {len(req.origin_input_ids_unpadded)=} => {len(req.origin_input_ids)} >= {self.max_req_input_len}."
   341	                    )
   342	                )
   343	                self._add_request_to_queue(req)
   344	                return
   345	
   346	        # Validate prompts length
   347	        error_msg = validate_input_length(
   348	            req,
   349	            self.max_req_input_len,
   350	            self.server_args.allow_auto_truncate,
   351	        )
   352	        if error_msg:
   353	            self._add_request_to_queue(req)
   354	            return
   355	
   356	        # Copy more attributes
   357	        req.logprob_start_len = len(req.origin_input_ids) - 1
   358	        self._add_request_to_queue(req)

   475	    def check_memory(self):
   476	        available_size = (
   477	            self.token_to_kv_pool_allocator.available_size()
   478	            + self.tree_cache.evictable_size()
   479	        )
   480	        protected_size = self.tree_cache.protected_size()
   481	        memory_leak = available_size != (
   482	            self.max_total_num_tokens
   483	            if not self.enable_hierarchical_cache
   484	            else self.max_total_num_tokens - protected_size
   485	        )
   486	        if memory_leak:
   487	            msg = (
   488	                "token_to_kv_pool_allocator memory leak detected! "
   489	                f"{available_size=}, {protected_size=}, {self.max_total_num_tokens=}\n"
   490	                f"{self.token_to_kv_pool_allocator.available_size()=}\n"
   491	                f"{self.tree_cache.evictable_size()=}\n"
   492	            )
   493	            raise ValueError(msg)
   494	
   495	        if len(self.req_to_token_pool.free_slots) != self.req_to_token_pool.size:
   496	            msg = (
   497	                "req_to_token_pool memory leak detected!"
   498	                f"available_size={len(self.req_to_token_pool.free_slots)}, "
   499	                f"total_size={self.req_to_token_pool.size}\n"
   500	            )
   501	            raise ValueError(msg)
   502	
   503	        if (
   504	            self.enable_metrics
   505	            and self.attn_tp_rank == 0
   506	            and time.perf_counter() > self.metrics_collector.last_log_time + 30
   507	        ):
   508	            # During idle time, also collect metrics every 30 seconds.
   509	            num_used = self.max_total_num_tokens - (
   510	                self.token_to_kv_pool_allocator.available_size()
   511	                + self.tree_cache.evictable_size()
   512	            )
   513	            num_running_reqs = len(self.running_batch.reqs)
   514	            self.stats.num_running_reqs = num_running_reqs
   515	            self.stats.num_used_tokens = num_used
   516	            self.stats.token_usage = num_used / self.max_total_num_tokens
   517	            self.stats.gen_throughput = 0
   518	            self.stats.num_queue_reqs = len(self.waiting_queue)
   519	            self.stats.num_grammar_queue_reqs = len(self.grammar_queue)

   523	    def coordinate_spec_dp_attn_batch(self, new_batch: Optional[ScheduleBatch]):
   524	        """Coordinate the DP attention batch."""
   525	
   526	        local_info = torch.tensor(
   527	            [
   528	                (new_batch is not None),
   529	            ],
   530	            dtype=torch.int64,
   531	        )
   532	        global_info = torch.empty(
   533	            (self.server_args.dp_size, self.attn_tp_size, 1),
   534	            dtype=torch.int64,
   535	        )
   536	        torch.distributed.all_gather_into_tensor(
   537	            global_info.flatten(),
   538	            local_info,
   539	            group=self.tp_cpu_group,
   540	        )
   541	        any_new_batch = any(
   542	            global_info[:, 0, 0].tolist()
   543	        )  # Any DP worker has forward batch
   544	        return any_new_batch

   546	    def get_next_batch_to_run(self) -> Optional[ScheduleBatch]:
   547	        # Merge the prefill batch into the running batch
   548	        chunked_req_to_exclude = set()
   549	        if self.chunked_req:
   550	            # Move the chunked request out of the batch so that we can merge
   551	            # only finished requests to running_batch.
   552	            chunked_req_to_exclude.add(self.chunked_req)
   553	            self.tree_cache.cache_unfinished_req(self.chunked_req)
   554	            # chunked request keeps its rid but will get a new req_pool_idx
   555	            self.req_to_token_pool.free(self.chunked_req.req_pool_idx)
   556	        if self.last_batch and self.last_batch.forward_mode.is_extend():
   557	            if self.last_batch.chunked_req is not None:
   558	                # In the context pipeline parallelism, after the last chunk, the current microbatch still track outdated chunked_req.
   559	                # We need to discard it.
   560	                chunked_req_to_exclude.add(self.last_batch.chunked_req)
   561	
   562	            # Filter batch
   563	            last_bs = self.last_batch.batch_size()
   564	            self.last_batch.filter_batch(
   565	                chunked_req_to_exclude=list(chunked_req_to_exclude)
   566	            )
   567	            if self.last_batch.batch_size() < last_bs:
   568	                self.running_batch.batch_is_full = False
   569	
   570	            # Merge the new batch into the running batch
   571	            if not self.last_batch.is_empty():
   572	                if self.running_batch.is_empty():
   573	                    self.running_batch = self.last_batch
   574	                else:
   575	                    # Merge running_batch with prefill batch
   576	                    self.running_batch.merge_batch(self.last_batch)
   577	
   578	        new_batch = self.get_new_batch_prefill()
   579	
   580	        # TODO(ch-wan): minor refactor is needed here to improve readability
   581	        any_new_batch = (
   582	            self.server_args.enable_dp_attention
   583	            and not self.spec_algorithm.is_none()
   584	            and self.coordinate_spec_dp_attn_batch(new_batch)
   585	        )
   586	        if new_batch is not None or any_new_batch:
   587	            # Run prefill first if possible
   588	            ret = new_batch
   589	        else:
   590	            # Run decode
   591	            if not self.running_batch.is_empty():
   592	                self.running_batch = self.update_running_batch(self.running_batch)
   593	                ret = self.running_batch if not self.running_batch.is_empty() else None
   594	            else:
   595	                ret = None
   596	
   597	        if require_mlp_sync(self.server_args):
   598	            ret, _ = self.prepare_mlp_sync_batch(ret)
   599	
   600	        return ret

   602	    def get_num_allocatable_reqs(self, running_bs):
   603	        res = global_server_args_dict["max_micro_batch_size"] - running_bs
   604	        if self.pp_size > 1:
   605	            res = min(res, self.req_to_token_pool.available_size())
   606	        return res

   608	    def get_new_batch_prefill(self) -> Optional[ScheduleBatch]:
   609	        # Check if the grammar is ready in the grammar queue
   610	        if self.grammar_queue:
   611	            self.move_ready_grammar_requests()
   612	
   613	        # Handle the cases where prefill is not allowed
   614	        if (
   615	            self.running_batch.batch_is_full or len(self.waiting_queue) == 0
   616	        ) and self.chunked_req is None:
   617	            return None
   618	
   619	        running_bs = len(self.running_batch.reqs)
   620	        # Ignore the check if self.chunked_req is not None.
   621	        # In the non-PP case, when self.chunked_req is not None, num_allocatable_reqs should always be greater than 0,
   622	        # as the space for the chunked request has just been released.
   623	        # In PP case, a chunked req can start in one microbatch and end in another microbatch, so the max_running_requests per microbatch should not be strict.
   624	        # Instead, we should always allow chunked request to be added, otherwise, there will be a memory leak.
   625	        if self.get_num_allocatable_reqs(running_bs) <= 0 and not self.chunked_req:
   626	            self.running_batch.batch_is_full = True
   627	            return None
   628	
   629	        if self.enable_hierarchical_cache:
   630	            self.tree_cache.check_hicache_events()
   631	
   632	        # Get priority queue
   633	        self.policy.calc_priority(self.waiting_queue)
   634	
   635	        # Prefill policy
   636	        adder = PrefillAdder(
   637	            self.page_size,
   638	            self.tree_cache,
   639	            self.token_to_kv_pool_allocator,
   640	            self.running_batch,
   641	            self.new_token_ratio,
   642	            self.max_prefill_tokens,
   643	            self.chunked_prefill_size,
   644	            running_bs if self.is_mixed_chunk else 0,
   645	        )
   646	
   647	        if self.chunked_req is not None:
   648	            self.chunked_req.init_next_round_input()
   649	            self.chunked_req = adder.add_chunked_req(self.chunked_req)
   650	
   651	        if self.lora_paths:
   652	            lora_set = set([req.lora_path for req in self.running_batch.reqs])
   653	
   654	        # Get requests from the waiting queue to a new prefill batch
   655	        for req in self.waiting_queue:
   656	            if (
   657	                self.lora_paths
   658	                and len(
   659	                    lora_set
   660	                    | set([req.lora_path for req in adder.can_run_list])
   661	                    | set([req.lora_path])
   662	                )
   663	                > self.max_loras_per_batch
   664	            ):
   665	                self.running_batch.batch_is_full = True
   666	                break
   667	
   668	            if len(adder.can_run_list) >= self.get_num_allocatable_reqs(running_bs):
   669	                self.running_batch.batch_is_full = True
   670	                break
   671	
   672	            if self.disaggregation_mode == DisaggregationMode.PREFILL:
   673	                # In prefill mode, prealloc queue and transfer queue can also take memory,
   674	                # so we need to check if the available size for the actual available size.
   675	                if len(adder.can_run_list) >= self.req_to_token_pool.available_size():
   676	                    self.running_batch.batch_is_full = True
   677	                    break
   678	
   679	            req.init_next_round_input(self.tree_cache)
   680	            res = adder.add_one_req(req, has_chunked_req=(self.chunked_req is not None))
   681	
   682	            if res != AddReqResult.CONTINUE:
   683	                if res == AddReqResult.NO_TOKEN:
   684	                    if self.enable_hierarchical_cache:
   685	                        # Set batch_is_full after making sure there are requests that can be served
   686	                        self.running_batch.batch_is_full = len(
   687	                            adder.can_run_list
   688	                        ) > 0 or (not self.running_batch.is_empty())
   689	                    else:
   690	                        self.running_batch.batch_is_full = True
   691	                break
   692	
   693	        # Update waiting queue
   694	        can_run_list: List[Req] = adder.can_run_list
   695	        if len(can_run_list) == 0:
   696	            return None
   697	
   698	        if self.enable_metrics:
   699	            # only record queue time when enable_metrics is True to avoid overhead
   700	            for req in can_run_list:
   701	                req.queue_time_end = time.perf_counter()
   702	
   703	        self.waiting_queue = [
   704	            x for x in self.waiting_queue if x not in set(can_run_list)
   705	        ]
   706	
   707	        if adder.new_chunked_req is not None:
   708	            assert self.chunked_req is None
   709	            self.chunked_req = adder.new_chunked_req
   710	
   711	        if self.chunked_req:
   712	            self.chunked_req.is_chunked += 1
   713	
   714	        # Print stats
   715	        if self.attn_tp_rank == 0:
   716	            self.log_prefill_stats(adder, can_run_list, running_bs)
   717	
   718	        # Create a new batch
   719	        new_batch = ScheduleBatch.init_new(
   720	            can_run_list,
   721	            self.req_to_token_pool,
   722	            self.token_to_kv_pool_allocator,
   723	            self.tree_cache,
   724	            self.model_config,
   725	            self.enable_overlap,
   726	            self.spec_algorithm,
   727	            self.server_args.enable_custom_logit_processor,
   728	            chunked_req=self.chunked_req,
   729	        )
   730	        if self.enable_hierarchical_cache:
   731	            # todo (zhiqiang): disable cuda graph execution if hicache loading triggered
   732	            new_batch.hicache_consumer_index = (
   733	                self.tree_cache.ready_to_load_host_cache()
   734	            )
   735	
   736	        new_batch.prepare_for_extend()
   737	
   738	        # Mixed-style chunked prefill
   739	        if (
   740	            self.is_mixed_chunk
   741	            and not self.running_batch.is_empty()
   742	            and not (new_batch.return_logprob or self.running_batch.return_logprob)
   743	        ):
   744	            # TODO (lianmin): support return_logprob + mixed chunked prefill
   745	            self.running_batch.filter_batch()
   746	            if not self.running_batch.is_empty():
   747	                self.running_batch.prepare_for_decode()
   748	                new_batch.mix_with_running(self.running_batch)
   749	                new_batch.decoding_reqs = self.running_batch.reqs
   750	            self.running_batch = ScheduleBatch(
   751	                reqs=[], batch_is_full=self.running_batch.batch_is_full
   752	            )
   753	        else:
   754	            new_batch.decoding_reqs = None
   755	
   756	        return new_batch
   757	
   758	    def update_running_batch(self, batch: ScheduleBatch) -> Optional[ScheduleBatch]:
   759	        """Update the current running decoding batch."""
   760	        initial_bs = batch.batch_size()
   761	
   762	        batch.filter_batch()
   763	        if batch.is_empty():
   764	            batch.batch_is_full = False
   765	            return batch
   766	
   767	        # Check if decode out of memory
   768	        if not batch.check_decode_mem(self.decode_mem_cache_buf_multiplier) or (
   769	            TEST_RETRACT and batch.batch_size() > 10
   770	        ):
   771	            old_ratio = self.new_token_ratio
   772	
   773	            retracted_reqs, new_token_ratio = batch.retract_decode(self.server_args)
   774	            self.new_token_ratio = new_token_ratio
   775	
   776	            logger.info(
   777	                "KV cache pool is full. Retract requests. "
   778	                f"#retracted_reqs: {len(retracted_reqs)}, "
   779	                f"#new_token_ratio: {old_ratio:.4f} -> {self.new_token_ratio:.4f}"
   780	            )
   781	            self._extend_requests_to_queue(retracted_reqs, is_retracted=True)
   782	        else:
   783	            self.new_token_ratio = max(
   784	                self.new_token_ratio - self.new_token_ratio_decay,
   785	                self.min_new_token_ratio,
   786	            )
   787	
   788	        if batch.batch_size() < initial_bs:
   789	            batch.batch_is_full = False
   790	
   791	        # Update batch tensors
   792	        batch.prepare_for_decode()
   793	        return batch

   795	    def run_batch(
   796	        self, batch: ScheduleBatch

   157	    def move_ready_grammar_requests(self):
   158	        """Move requests whose grammar objects are ready from grammar_queue to waiting_queue."""
   159	
   160	        num_ready_reqs = 0
   161	        num_timeout_reqs = 0
   162	        for req in self.grammar_queue:
   163	            try:
   164	                if req.finished():  # It is aborted by AbortReq
   165	                    num_ready_reqs += 1
   166	                    continue
   167	                req.grammar = req.grammar.result(timeout=0.03)
   168	                self.grammar_backend.set_cache(req.grammar_key, req.grammar.copy())
   169	                if req.grammar is INVALID_GRAMMAR_OBJ:
   170	                    req.set_finish_with_abort(
   171	                        f"Invalid grammar request: {req.grammar_key=}"
   172	                    )
   173	                num_ready_reqs += 1
   174	            except futures._base.TimeoutError:
   175	                req.grammar_wait_ct += 1
   176	                # NOTE(lianmin): this timeout is the waiting time of the above line. It is
   177	                # not the waiting time from it enters the grammar queue.
   178	                if req.grammar_wait_ct > GRAMMAR_TIMEOUT / 0.03:
   179	                    num_timeout_reqs = 1
   180	                break
   181	
   182	        if self.server_args.enable_dp_attention:
   183	            tp_size = self.attn_tp_size
   184	            tp_group = self.attn_tp_cpu_group
   185	        else:
   186	            tp_size = self.tp_size
   187	            tp_group = self.tp_cpu_group
   188	
   189	        if tp_size > 1:
   190	            # Sync across TP ranks to make sure they have the same number of ready requests
   191	            tensor = torch.tensor([num_ready_reqs, num_timeout_reqs], dtype=torch.int32)
   192	            torch.distributed.all_reduce(
   193	                tensor, op=torch.distributed.ReduceOp.MAX, group=tp_group
   194	            )
   195	            num_ready_reqs_max, num_timeout_reqs_max = tensor.tolist()
   196	
   197	            for i in range(num_ready_reqs, num_ready_reqs_max):
   198	                req = self.grammar_queue[i]
   199	                if req.finished():  # It is aborted by AbortReq
   200	                    continue
   201	                req.grammar = req.grammar.result()
   202	                self.grammar_backend.set_cache(req.grammar_key, req.grammar.copy())
   203	                if req.grammar is INVALID_GRAMMAR_OBJ:
   204	                    req.set_finish_with_abort(
   205	                        f"Invalid grammar request: {req.grammar_key=}"
   206	                    )
   207	        else:
   208	            num_ready_reqs_max = num_ready_reqs
   209	            num_timeout_reqs_max = num_timeout_reqs
   210	
   211	        for i in range(num_ready_reqs, num_ready_reqs + num_timeout_reqs_max):
   212	            req = self.grammar_queue[i]
   213	            req.grammar.cancel()
   214	            error_msg = f"Grammar preprocessing timed out for {req.grammar_key=}"
   215	            req.set_finish_with_abort(error_msg)
   216	            self.grammar_backend.set_cache(req.grammar_key, INVALID_GRAMMAR_OBJ)
   217	        num_ready_reqs = num_ready_reqs_max + num_timeout_reqs_max
   218	
   219	        self._extend_requests_to_queue(self.grammar_queue[:num_ready_reqs])
   220	        self.grammar_queue = self.grammar_queue[num_ready_reqs:]

   229	    def watchdog_thread(self):
   230	        """A watch dog thread that will try to kill the server itself if one forward batch takes too long."""
   231	        self.watchdog_last_forward_ct = 0
   232	        self.watchdog_last_time = time.perf_counter()
   233	
   234	        while True:
   235	            current = time.perf_counter()
   236	            if self.cur_batch is not None:
   237	                if self.watchdog_last_forward_ct == self.forward_ct:
   238	                    if current > self.watchdog_last_time + self.watchdog_timeout:
   239	                        break
   240	                else:
   241	                    self.watchdog_last_forward_ct = self.forward_ct
   242	                    self.watchdog_last_time = current
   243	            time.sleep(self.watchdog_timeout // 2)
   244	
   245	        if not disable_request_logging():
   246	            # Print batch size and memory pool info to check whether there are de-sync issues.
   247	            logger.error(
   248	                f"{self.cur_batch.batch_size()=}, "
   249	                f"{self.cur_batch.reqs=}, "
   250	                f"{self.token_to_kv_pool_allocator.available_size()=}, "
   251	                f"{self.tree_cache.evictable_size()=}, "
   252	            )
   253	
   254	        pyspy_dump_schedulers()
   255	        logger.error(f"Watchdog timeout ({self.watchdog_timeout=})")
   256	        print(file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
   257	        print(file=sys.stdout, flush=True)
   258	
   259	        # Wait for some time so that the parent process can print the error.
   260	        time.sleep(5)
   261	        self.parent_process.send_signal(signal.SIGQUIT)

   412	    def abort_request(self, recv_req: AbortReq):
   413	        # Delete requests in the waiting queue
   414	        to_del = []
   415	        for i, req in enumerate(self.waiting_queue):
   416	            if req.rid.startswith(recv_req.rid):
   417	                to_del.append(i)
   418	
   419	        # Sort in reverse order to avoid index issues when deleting
   420	        for i in reversed(to_del):
   421	            # Abort method 1: directly pop from the queue
   422	            # This only works for requests that have not started anything.
   423	            # We still need to send something back to TokenizerManager to clean up the state.

def coordinate_spec_dp_attn_batch(self, new_batch: Optional[ScheduleBatch]):
        """Coordinate the DP attention batch."""

        local_info = torch.tensor(

        global_info = torch.empty(
            (self.server_args.dp_size, self.attn_tp_size, 1),

        )
        any_new_batch = any(
            global_info[:, 0, 0].tolist()
        )  # Any DP worker has forward batch
        return any_new_batch

   185	class IdleSleeper:
   186	    """
   187	    In setups which have long inactivity periods it is desirable to reduce
   188	    system power consumption when sglang does nothing. This would lead not only
   189	    to power savings, but also to more CPU thermal headroom when a request
   190	    eventually comes. This is important in cases when multiple GPUs are connected
   191	    as each GPU would otherwise pin one thread at 100% CPU usage.
   192	
   193	    The simplest solution is to use zmq.Poller on all sockets that may receive
   194	    data that needs handling immediately.
   195	    """
   196	
   197	    def __init__(self, sockets):
   198	        self.poller = zmq.Poller()
   199	        for s in sockets:
   200	            self.poller.register(s, zmq.POLLIN)
   201	
   202	    def maybe_sleep(self):
   203	        self.poller.poll(1000)

   521	    def event_loop_overlap(self):
   522	        """A scheduler loop that overlaps the CPU processing and GPU computation."""
   523	        self.result_queue = deque()
   524

   530	            self.cur_batch = batch

   533	                batch.launch_done = threading.Event()
   534	                result = self.run_batch(batch)
   535	                self.result_queue.append((batch.copy(), result))

   539	                    # It is now used for triggering the sampling_info_done event.
   540	                    tmp_batch = ScheduleBatch(

   542	                        forward_mode=ForwardMode.DUMMY_FIRST,
   543	                        next_batch_sampling_info=self.tp_worker.cur_sampling_info,
   544	                    )
   545	                    self.process_batch_result(tmp_batch, None, batch.launch_done)
   546	
   547	            if self.last_batch:
   548	                # Process the results of the last batch
   549	                tmp_batch, tmp_result = self.result_queue.popleft()
   550	                tmp_batch.next_batch_sampling_info = (
   551	                    self.tp_worker.cur_sampling_info if batch else None

   554	                self.process_batch_result(

   561	                self.maybe_sleep_on_idle()

   475	    def check_memory(self):
   476	        available_size = (
   477	            self.token_to_kv_pool_allocator.available_size()
   478	            + self.tree_cache.evictable_size()
   479	        )
   480	        protected_size = self.tree_cache.protected_size()
   481	        memory_leak = available_size != (
   482	            self.max_total_num_tokens
   483	            if not self.enable_hierarchical_cache
   484	            else self.max_total_num_tokens - protected_size
   485	        )
   486	        if memory_leak:
   487	            msg = (
   488	                "token_to_kv_pool_allocator memory leak detected! "
   489	                f"{available_size=}, {protected_size=}, {self.max_total_num_tokens=}\n"
   490	                f"{self.token_to_kv_pool_allocator.available_size()=}\n"
   491	                f"{self.tree_cache.evictable_size()=}\n"
   492	            )
   493	            raise ValueError(msg)
   494	
   495	        if len(self.req_to_token_pool.free_slots) != self.req_to_token_pool.size:
   496	            msg = (
   497	                "req_to_token_pool memory leak detected!"
   498	                f"available_size={len(self.req_to_token_pool.free_slots)}, "
   499	                f"total_size={self.req_to_token_pool.size}\n"
   500	            )
   501	            raise ValueError(msg)
   502	
   503	        if (
   504	            self.enable_metrics
   505	            and self.attn_tp_rank == 0
   506	            and time.perf_counter() > self.metrics_collector.last_log_time + 30
   507	        ):
   508	            # During idle time, also collect metrics every 30 seconds.
   509	            num_used = self.max_total_num_tokens - (
   510	                self.token_to_kv_pool_allocator.available_size()
   511	                + self.tree_cache.evictable_size()
   512	            )
   513	            num_running_reqs = len(self.running_batch.reqs)
   514	            self.stats.num_running_reqs = num_running_reqs
   515	            self.stats.num_used_tokens = num_used
   516	            self.stats.token_usage = num_used / self.max_total_num_tokens
   517	            self.stats.gen_throughput = 0
   518	            self.stats.num_queue_reqs = len(self.waiting_queue)
   519	            self.stats.num_grammar_queue_reqs = len(self.grammar_queue)

   523	    def coordinate_spec_dp_attn_batch(self, new_batch: Optional[ScheduleBatch]):
   524	        """Coordinate the DP attention batch."""
   525	
   526	        local_info = torch.tensor(
   527	            [
   528	                (new_batch is not None),
   529	            ],
   530	            dtype=torch.int64,
   531	        )
   532	        global_info = torch.empty(
   533	            (self.server_args.dp_size, self.attn_tp_size, 1),
   534	            dtype=torch.int64,
   535	        )
   536	        torch.distributed.all_gather_into_tensor(
   537	            global_info.flatten(),
   538	            local_info,
   539	            group=self.tp_cpu_group,
   540	        )
   541	        any_new_batch = any(
   542	            global_info[:, 0, 0].tolist()
   543	        )  # Any DP worker has forward batch
   544	        return any_new_batch

   546	    def get_next_batch_to_run(self) -> Optional[ScheduleBatch]:
   547	        # Merge the prefill batch into the running batch
   548	        chunked_req_to_exclude = set()
   549	        if self.chunked_req:
   550	            # Move the chunked request out of the batch so that we can merge
   551	            # only finished requests to running_batch.
   552	            chunked_req_to_exclude.add(self.chunked_req)
   553	            self.tree_cache.cache_unfinished_req(self.chunked_req)
   554	            # chunked request keeps its rid but will get a new req_pool_idx
   555	            self.req_to_token_pool.free(self.chunked_req.req_pool_idx)
   556	        if self.last_batch and self.last_batch.forward_mode.is_extend():
   557	            if self.last_batch.chunked_req is not None:
   558	                # In the context pipeline parallelism, after the last chunk, the current microbatch still track outdated chunked_req.
   559	                # We need to discard it.
   560	                chunked_req_to_exclude.add(self.last_batch.chunked_req)
   561	
   562	            # Filter batch
   563	            last_bs = self.last_batch.batch_size()
   564	            self.last_batch.filter_batch(
   565	                chunked_req_to_exclude=list(chunked_req_to_exclude)
   566	            )
   567	            if self.last_batch.batch_size() < last_bs:
   568	                self.running_batch.batch_is_full = False
   569	
   570	            # Merge the new batch into the running batch
   571	            if not self.last_batch.is_empty():
   572	                if self.running_batch.is_empty():
   573	                    self.running_batch = self.last_batch
   574	                else:
   575	                    # Merge running_batch with prefill batch
   576	                    self.running_batch.merge_batch(self.last_batch)
   577	
   578	        new_batch = self.get_new_batch_prefill()
   579	
   580	        # TODO(ch-wan): minor refactor is needed here to improve readability
   581	        any_new_batch = (
   582	            self.server_args.enable_dp_attention
   583	            and not self.spec_algorithm.is_none()
   584	            and self.coordinate_spec_dp_attn_batch(new_batch)
   585	        )

   608	    def get_new_batch_prefill(self) -> Optional[ScheduleBatch]:
   609	        # Check if the grammar is ready in the grammar queue
   610	        if self.grammar_queue:
   611	            self.move_ready_grammar_requests()
   612	
   613	        # Handle the cases where prefill is not allowed
   614	        if (
   615	            self.running_batch.batch_is_full or len(self.waiting_queue) == 0
   616	        ) and self.chunked_req is None:
   617	            return None
   618	
   619	        running_bs = len(self.running_batch.reqs)
   620	        # Ignore the check if self.chunked_req is not None.
   621	        # In the non-PP case, when self.chunked_req is not None, num_allocatable_reqs should always be greater than 0,
   622	        # as the space for the chunked request has just been released.
   623	        # In PP case, a chunked req can start in one microbatch and end in another microbatch, so the max_running_requests per microbatch should not be strict.
   624	        # Instead, we should always allow chunked request to be added, otherwise, there will be a memory leak.
   625	        if self.get_num_allocatable_reqs(running_bs) <= 0 and not self.chunked_req:
   626	            self.running_batch.batch_is_full = True
   627	            return None
   628	
   629	        if self.enable_hierarchical_cache:
   630	            self.tree_cache.check_hicache_events()
   631	
   632	        # Get priority queue
   633	        self.policy.calc_priority(self.waiting_queue)
   634	
   635	        # Prefill policy
   636	        adder = PrefillAdder(
   637	            self.page_size,
   638	            self.tree_cache,
   639	            self.token_to_kv_pool_allocator,
   640	            self.running_batch,
   641	            self.new_token_ratio,
   642	            self.max_prefill_tokens,
   643	            self.chunked_prefill_size,
   644	            running_bs if self.is_mixed_chunk else 0,
   645	        )
   646	
   647	        if self.chunked_req is not None:
   648	            self.chunked_req.init_next_round_input()
   649	            self.chunked_req = adder.add_chunked_req(self.chunked_req)
   650	
   651	        if self.lora_paths:
   652	            lora_set = set([req.lora_path for req in self.running_batch.reqs])
   653	
   654	        # Get requests from the waiting queue to a new prefill batch
   655	        for req in self.waiting_queue:
   656	            if (
   657	                self.lora_paths
   658	                and len(
   659	                    lora_set
   660	                    | set([req.lora_path for req in adder.can_run_list])
   661	                    | set([req.lora_path])
   662	                )
   663	                > self.max_loras_per_batch
   664	            ):
   665	                self.running_batch.batch_is_full = True
   666	                break

   668	            if len(adder.can_run_list) >= self.get_num_allocatable_reqs(running_bs):

   672	            if self.disaggregation_mode == DisaggregationMode.PREFILL:

   674	                # so we need to check if the available size for the actual available size.
   675	                if len(adder.can_run_list) >= self.req_to_token_pool.available_size():

   679	            req.init_next_round_input(self.tree_cache)

   681

   684	                    if self.enable_hierarchical_cache:

   687	                            adder.can_run_list
   688	                        ) > 0 or (not self.running_batch.is_empty())
   689	                    else:
   690	                        self.running_batch.batch_is_full = True

   694	        can_run_list: List[Req] = adder.can_run_list
   695	        if len(can_run_list) == 0:
   696	            return None
   697	
   698	        if self.enable_metrics:
   699	            # only record queue time when enable_metrics is True to avoid overhead
   700	            for req in can_run_list:
   701	                req.queue_time_end = time.perf_counter()
   702	
   703	        self.waiting_queue = [
   704	            x for x in self.waiting_queue if x not in set(can_run_list)
   705	        ]
   706	
   707	        if adder.new_chunked_req is not None:
   708	            assert self.chunked_req is None
   709	            self.chunked_req = adder.new_chunked_req

   711	        if self.chunked_req:

   714	        # Print stats
   715	        if self.attn_tp_rank == 0:
   716	            self.log_prefill_stats(adder, can_run_list, running_bs)
   717	
   718	        # Create a new batch
   719	        new_batch = ScheduleBatch.init_new(
   720	            can_run_list,
   721	            self.req_to_token_pool,
   722	            self.token_to_kv_pool_allocator,
   723	            self.tree_cache,
   724	            self.model_config,

   738	        # Mixed-style chunked prefill

   740	            self.is_mixed_chunk
   741	            and not self.running_batch.is_empty()

   751	                reqs=[], batch_is_full=self.running_batch.batch_is_full

   753	        else:

   758	    def update_running_batch(self, batch: ScheduleBatch) -> Optional[ScheduleBatch]:
   759	        """Update the current running decoding batch."""

   762	        batch.filter_batch()

   773	            retracted_reqs, new_token_ratio = batch.retract_decode(self.server_args)
   774	            self.new_token_ratio = new_token_ratio

   239	            req.logprob_start_len = recv_req.logprob_start_len
   240	
   241	        if req.logprob_start_len >= len(req.origin_input_ids):
   242	            error_msg = f"{req.logprob_start_len=} is higher than the number of input tokens {len(req.origin_input_ids)=}. Please use a smaller logprob_start_len."
   243	            req.logprob_start_len = len(req.origin_input_ids) - 1
   244	            req.set_finish_with_abort(error_msg)
   245	            self._add_request_to_queue(req)
   246	            return
   247	
   248	        req.sampling_params.max_new_tokens = min(
   249	            (
   250	                req.sampling_params.max_new_tokens
   251	                if req.sampling_params.max_new_tokens is not None
   252	                else 1 << 30
   253	            ),
   254	            self.max_req_len - len(req.origin_input_ids) - 1,
   255	        )
   256	
   257	        # Init grammar cache for this request
   258	        add_to_grammar_queue = False
   259	        if (
   260	            req.sampling_params.json_schema is not None
   261	            or req.sampling_params.regex is not None
   262	            or req.sampling_params.ebnf is not None
   263	            or req.sampling_params.structural_tag is not None
   264	        ):
   265	            assert self.grammar_backend is not None
   266	            if req.sampling_params.json_schema is not None:
   267	                key = ("json", req.sampling_params.json_schema)
   268	            elif req.sampling_params.regex is not None:
   269	                key = ("regex", req.sampling_params.regex)
   270	            elif req.sampling_params.ebnf is not None:
   271	                key = ("ebnf", req.sampling_params.ebnf)
   272	            elif req.sampling_params.structural_tag:
   273	                key = ("structural_tag", req.sampling_params.structural_tag)
   274	
   275	            value, cache_hit = self.grammar_backend.get_cached_or_future_value(key)
   276	            req.grammar = value
   277	
   278	            if not cache_hit:
   279	                req.grammar_key = key
   280	                add_to_grammar_queue = True
   281	            else:
   282	                if value is INVALID_GRAMMAR_OBJ:  # We hit a cached invalid grammar.
   283	                    error_msg = f"Invalid grammar request with cache hit: {key=}"
   284	                    req.set_finish_with_abort(error_msg)
   285	
   286	        if add_to_grammar_queue:
   287	            req.queue_time_start = time.perf_counter()
   288	            self.grammar_queue.append(req)
   289	        else:
   290	            self._add_request_to_queue(req)

   292	    def _add_request_to_queue(self, req: Req):
   293	        req.queue_time_start = time.perf_counter()
   294	        if self.disaggregation_mode == DisaggregationMode.PREFILL:
   295	            self.disagg_prefill_bootstrap_queue.add(
   296	                req, self.model_config.num_key_value_heads
   297	            )
   298	        elif self.disaggregation_mode == DisaggregationMode.DECODE:
   299	            self.disagg_decode_prealloc_queue.add(req)
   300	        else:
   301	            self.waiting_queue.append(req)

   303	    def _extend_requests_to_queue(self, reqs: List[Req], is_retracted: bool = False):
   304	        if self.disaggregation_mode == DisaggregationMode.PREFILL:
   305	            self.disagg_prefill_bootstrap_queue.extend(
   306	                reqs, self.model_config.num_key_value_heads
   307	            )
   308	        elif self.disaggregation_mode == DisaggregationMode.DECODE:
   309	            # If this is a decode server, we put the request to the decode pending prealloc queue
   310	            self.disagg_decode_prealloc_queue.extend(reqs, is_retracted)
   311	        else:
   312	            self.waiting_queue.extend(reqs)

   315	        self,
   316	        recv_req: TokenizedEmbeddingReqInput,
   317	    ):
   318	        req = Req(
   319	            recv_req.rid,

   321	            recv_req.input_ids,

   324	        )

   326	
   327	        # Handle multimodal inputs
   328	        if recv_req.image_inputs is not None:
   329	            image_inputs = MultimodalInputs.from_dict(recv_req.image_inputs)
   330	            # Expand a single image token into multiple dummy tokens for receiving image embeddings
   331	            req.origin_input_ids = self.pad_input_ids_func(
   332	                req.origin_input_ids, image_inputs
   333	            )
   334	            req.extend_image_inputs(image_inputs)
   335	
   336	            if len(req.origin_input_ids) >= self.max_req_input_len:
   337	                req.set_finish_with_abort(
   338	                    error_msg=(
   339	                        "Multimodal prompt is too long after expanding multimodal tokens. "
   340	                        f"After expanding {len(req.origin_input_ids_unpadded)=} => {len(req.origin_input_ids)} >= {self.max_req_input_len}."
   341	                    )
   342	                )
   343	                self._add_request_to_queue(req)

   346	        # Validate prompts length
   347	        error_msg = validate_input_length(
   348	            req,
   349	            self.max_req_input_len,
   350	            self.server_args.allow_auto_truncate,
   351	        )
   352	        if error_msg:
   353	            self._add_request_to_queue(req)
   354	            return
   355	
   356	        # Copy more attributes
   357	        req.logprob_start_len = len(req.origin_input_ids) - 1
   358	        self._add_request_to_queue(req)

   475	    def check_memory(self):
   476	        available_size = (
   477	            self.token_to_kv_pool_allocator.available_size()
   478	            + self.tree_cache.evictable_size()
   479	        )
   480	        protected_size = self.tree_cache.protected_size()
   481	        memory_leak = available_size != (
   482	            self.max_total_num_tokens
   483	            if not self.enable_hierarchical_cache
   484	            else self.max_total_num_tokens - protected_size
   485	        )
   486	        if memory_leak:
   487	            msg = (
   488	                "token_to_kv_pool_allocator memory leak detected! "
   489	                f"{available_size=}, {protected_size=}, {self.max_total_num_tokens=}\n"
   490	                f"{self.token_to_kv_pool_allocator.available_size()=}\n"
   491	                f"{self.tree_cache.evictable_size()=}\n"
   492	            )
   493	            raise ValueError(msg)
   494	
   495	        if len(self.req_to_token_pool.free_slots) != self.req_to_token_pool.size:
   496	            msg = (
   497	                "req_to_token_pool memory leak detected!"
   498	                f"available_size={len(self.req_to_token_pool.free_slots)}, "
   499	                f"total_size={self.req_to_token_pool.size}\n"
   500	            )
   501	            raise ValueError(msg)
   502	
   503	        if (
   504	            self.enable_metrics
   505	            and self.attn_tp_rank == 0
   506	            and time.perf_counter() > self.metrics_collector.last_log_time + 30
   507	        ):
   508	            # During idle time, also collect metrics every 30 seconds.
   509	            num_used = self.max_total_num_tokens - (
   510	                self.token_to_kv_pool_allocator.available_size()
   511	                + self.tree_cache.evictable_size()
   512	            )
   513	            num_running_reqs = len(self.running_batch.reqs)
   514	            self.stats.num_running_reqs = num_running_reqs
   515	            self.stats.num_used_tokens = num_used
   516	            self.stats.token_usage = num_used / self.max_total_num_tokens
   517	            self.stats.gen_throughput = 0
   518	            self.stats.num_queue_reqs = len(self.waiting_queue)
   519	            self.stats.num_grammar_queue_reqs = len(self.grammar_queue)
   520	            self.metrics_collector.log_stats(self.stats)
   521	        self._publish_kv_events()

   523	    def coordinate_spec_dp_attn_batch(self, new_batch: Optional[ScheduleBatch]):
   524	        """Coordinate the DP attention batch."""
   525	
   526	        local_info = torch.tensor(
   527	            [
   528	                (new_batch is not None),
   529	            ],
   530	            dtype=torch.int64,
   531	        )
   532	        global_info = torch.empty(
   533	            (self.server_args.dp_size, self.attn_tp_size, 1),
   534	            dtype=torch.int64,
   535	        )
   536	        torch.distributed.all_gather_into_tensor(
   537	            global_info.flatten(),
   538	            local_info,
   539	            group=self.tp_cpu_group,
   540	        )
   541	        any_new_batch = any(
   542	            global_info[:, 0, 0].tolist()
   543	        )  # Any DP worker has forward batch
   544	        return any_new_batch
   545	
   546	    def get_next_batch_to_run(self) -> Optional[ScheduleBatch]:
   547	        # Merge the prefill batch into the running batch
   548	        chunked_req_to_exclude = set()
   549	        if self.chunked_req:
   550	            # Move the chunked request out of the batch so that we can merge
   551	            # only finished requests to running_batch.
   552	            chunked_req_to_exclude.add(self.chunked_req)
   553	            self.tree_cache.cache_unfinished_req(self.chunked_req)
   554	            # chunked request keeps its rid but will get a new req_pool_idx
   555	            self.req_to_token_pool.free(self.chunked_req.req_pool_idx)
   556	        if self.last_batch and self.last_batch.forward_mode.is_extend():
   557	            if self.last_batch.chunked_req is not None:
   558	                # In the context pipeline parallelism, after the last chunk, the current microbatch still track outdated chunked_req.
   559	                # We need to discard it.
   560	                chunked_req_to_exclude.add(self.last_batch.chunked_req)
   561	
   562	            # Filter batch
   563	            last_bs = self.last_batch.batch_size()
   564	            self.last_batch.filter_batch(
   565	                chunked_req_to_exclude=list(chunked_req_to_exclude)
   566	            )
   567	            if self.last_batch.batch_size() < last_bs:
   568	                self.running_batch.batch_is_full = False
   569	
   570	            # Merge the new batch into the running batch
   571	            if not self.last_batch.is_empty():
   572	                if self.running_batch.is_empty():
   573	                    self.running_batch = self.last_batch
   574	                else:
   575	                    # Merge running_batch with prefill batch
   576	                    self.running_batch.merge_batch(self.last_batch)
   577	
   578	        new_batch = self.get_new_batch_prefill()
   579	
   580	        # TODO(ch-wan): minor refactor is needed here to improve readability
   581	        any_new_batch = (
   582	            self.server_args.enable_dp_attention
   583	            and not self.spec_algorithm.is_none()
   584	            and self.coordinate_spec_dp_attn_batch(new_batch)
   585	        )
   586	        if new_batch is not None or any_new_batch:
   587	            # Run prefill first if possible
   588	            ret = new_batch
   589	        else:
   590	            # Run decode
   591	            if not self.running_batch.is_empty():
   592	                self.running_batch = self.update_running_batch(self.running_batch)
   593	                ret = self.running_batch if not self.running_batch.is_empty() else None
   594	            else:
   595	                ret = None
   596	
   597	        if require_mlp_sync(self.server_args):
   598	            ret, _ = self.prepare_mlp_sync_batch(ret)
   599	
   600	        return ret

   602	    def get_num_allocatable_reqs(self, running_bs):
   603	        res = global_server_args_dict["max_micro_batch_size"] - running_bs
   604	        if self.pp_size > 1:
   605	            res = min(res, self.req_to_token_pool.available_size())
   606	        return res

   608	    def get_new_batch_prefill(self) -> Optional[ScheduleBatch]:
   609	        # Check if the grammar is ready in the grammar queue
   610	        if self.grammar_queue:
   611	            self.move_ready_grammar_requests()
   612	
   613	        # Handle the cases where prefill is not allowed
   614	        if (
   615	            self.running_batch.batch_is_full or len(self.waiting_queue) == 0
   616	        ) and self.chunked_req is None:
   617	            return None
   618	
   619	        running_bs = len(self.running_batch.reqs)
   620	        # Ignore the check if self.chunked_req is not None.
   621	        # In the non-PP case, when self.chunked_req is not None, num_allocatable_reqs should always be greater than 0,
   622	        # as the space for the chunked request has just been released.
   623	        # In PP case, a chunked req can start in one microbatch and end in another microbatch, so the max_running_requests per microbatch should not be strict.
   624	        # Instead, we should always allow chunked request to be added, otherwise, there will be a memory leak.
   625	        if self.get_num_allocatable_reqs(running_bs) <= 0 and not self.chunked_req:
   626	            self.running_batch.batch_is_full = True
   627	            return None
   628	
   629	        if self.enable_hierarchical_cache:
   630	            self.tree_cache.check_hicache_events()
   631	
   632	        # Get priority queue
   633	        self.policy.calc_priority(self.waiting_queue)
   634	
   635	        # Prefill policy
   636	        adder = PrefillAdder(
   637	            self.page_size,
   638	            self.tree_cache,
   639	            self.token_to_kv_pool_allocator,
   640	            self.running_batch,
   641	            self.new_token_ratio,
   642	            self.max_prefill_tokens,
   643	            self.chunked_prefill_size,
   644	            running_bs if self.is_mixed_chunk else 0,
   645	        )
   646	
   647	        if self.chunked_req is not None:
   648	            self.chunked_req.init_next_round_input()
   649	            self.chunked_req = adder.add_chunked_req(self.chunked_req)
   650	
   651	        if self.lora_paths:
   652	            lora_set = set([req.lora_path for req in self.running_batch.reqs])
   653	
   654	        # Get requests from the waiting queue to a new prefill batch
   655	        for req in self.waiting_queue:
   656	            if (
   657	                self.lora_paths
   658	                and len(
   659	                    lora_set
   660	                    | set([req.lora_path for req in adder.can_run_list])
   661	                    | set([req.lora_path])
   662	                )
   663	                > self.max_loras_per_batch
   664	            ):
   665	                self.running_batch.batch_is_full = True
   666	                break
   667	
   668	            if len(adder.can_run_list) >= self.get_num_allocatable_reqs(running_bs):
   669	                self.running_batch.batch_is_full = True
   670	                break
   671	
   672	            if self.disaggregation_mode == DisaggregationMode.PREFILL:
   673	                # In prefill mode, prealloc queue and transfer queue can also take memory,
   674	                # so we need to check if the available size for the actual available size.
   675	                if len(adder.can_run_list) >= self.req_to_token_pool.available_size():
   676	                    self.running_batch.batch_is_full = True
   677	                    break
   678	
   679	            req.init_next_round_input(self.tree_cache)
   680	            res = adder.add_one_req(req, has_chunked_req=(self.chunked_req is not None))
   681	
   682	            if res != AddReqResult.CONTINUE:
   683	                if res == AddReqResult.NO_TOKEN:
   684	                    if self.enable_hierarchical_cache:
   685	                        # Set batch_is_full after making sure there are requests that can be served
   686	                        self.running_batch.batch_is_full = len(
   687	                            adder.can_run_list
   688	                        ) > 0 or (not self.running_batch.is_empty())
   689	                    else:
   690	                        self.running_batch.batch_is_full = True
   691	                break
   692	
   693	        # Update waiting queue
   694	        can_run_list: List[Req] = adder.can_run_list
   695	        if len(can_run_list) == 0:
   696	            return None
   697	
   698	        if self.enable_metrics:
   699	            # only record queue time when enable_metrics is True to avoid overhead
   700	            for req in can_run_list:
   701	                req.queue_time_end = time.perf_counter()
   702	
   703	        self.waiting_queue = [
   704	            x for x in self.waiting_queue if x not in set(can_run_list)
   705	        ]
   706	
   707	        if adder.new_chunked_req is not None:
   708	            assert self.chunked_req is None
   709	            self.chunked_req = adder.new_chunked_req
   710	
   711	        if self.chunked_req:
   712	            self.chunked_req.is_chunked += 1
   713	
   714	        # Print stats
   715	        if self.attn_tp_rank == 0:
   716	            self.log_prefill_stats(adder, can_run_list, running_bs)
   717	
   718	        # Create a new batch
   719	        new_batch = ScheduleBatch.init_new(
   720	            can_run_list,
   721	            self.req_to_token_pool,
   722	            self.token_to_kv_pool_allocator,
   723	            self.tree_cache,
   724	            self.model_config,
   725	            self.enable_overlap,
   726	            self.spec_algorithm,
   727	            self.server_args.enable_custom_logit_processor,
   728	            chunked_req=self.chunked_req,
   729	        )
   730	        if self.enable_hierarchical_cache:
   731	            # todo (zhiqiang): disable cuda graph execution if hicache loading triggered
   732	            new_batch.hicache_consumer_index = (
   733	                self.tree_cache.ready_to_load_host_cache()
   734	            )
   735	
   736	        new_batch.prepare_for_extend()

   157	    def move_ready_grammar_requests(self):
   158	        """Move requests whose grammar objects are ready from grammar_queue to waiting_queue."""
   159	
   160	        num_ready_reqs = 0
   161	        num_timeout_reqs = 0
   162	        for req in self.grammar_queue:
   163	            try:
   164	                if req.finished():  # It is aborted by AbortReq
   165	                    num_ready_reqs += 1
   166	                    continue
   167	                req.grammar = req.grammar.result(timeout=0.03)
   168	                self.grammar_backend.set_cache(req.grammar_key, req.grammar.copy())
   169	                if req.grammar is INVALID_GRAMMAR_OBJ:
   170	                    req.set_finish_with_abort(
   171	                        f"Invalid grammar request: {req.grammar_key=}"
   172	                    )
   173	                num_ready_reqs += 1
   174	            except futures._base.TimeoutError:
   175	                req.grammar_wait_ct += 1
   176	                # NOTE(lianmin): this timeout is the waiting time of the above line. It is
   177	                # not the waiting time from it enters the grammar queue.
   178	                if req.grammar_wait_ct > GRAMMAR_TIMEOUT / 0.03:
   179	                    num_timeout_reqs = 1
   180	                break
   181	
   182	        if self.server_args.enable_dp_attention:
   183	            tp_size = self.attn_tp_size
   184	            tp_group = self.attn_tp_cpu_group
   185	        else:
   186	            tp_size = self.tp_size
   187	            tp_group = self.tp_cpu_group
   188	
   189	        if tp_size > 1:
   190	            # Sync across TP ranks to make sure they have the same number of ready requests
   191	            tensor = torch.tensor([num_ready_reqs, num_timeout_reqs], dtype=torch.int32)
   192	            torch.distributed.all_reduce(
   193	                tensor, op=torch.distributed.ReduceOp.MAX, group=tp_group
   194	            )
   195	            num_ready_reqs_max, num_timeout_reqs_max = tensor.tolist()
   196	
   197	            for i in range(num_ready_reqs, num_ready_reqs_max):
   198	                req = self.grammar_queue[i]
   199	                if req.finished():  # It is aborted by AbortReq
   200	                    continue
   201	                req.grammar = req.grammar.result()
   202	                self.grammar_backend.set_cache(req.grammar_key, req.grammar.copy())
   203	                if req.grammar is INVALID_GRAMMAR_OBJ:
   204	                    req.set_finish_with_abort(
   205	                        f"Invalid grammar request: {req.grammar_key=}"
   206	                    )
   207	        else:
   208	            num_ready_reqs_max = num_ready_reqs
   209	            num_timeout_reqs_max = num_timeout_reqs
   210	
   211	        for i in range(num_ready_reqs, num_ready_reqs + num_timeout_reqs_max):
   212	            req = self.grammar_queue[i]
   213	            req.grammar.cancel()
   214	            error_msg = f"Grammar preprocessing timed out for {req.grammar_key=}"
   215	            req.set_finish_with_abort(error_msg)
   216	            self.grammar_backend.set_cache(req.grammar_key, INVALID_GRAMMAR_OBJ)
   217	        num_ready_reqs = num_ready_reqs_max + num_timeout_reqs_max
   218	
   219	        self._extend_requests_to_queue(self.grammar_queue[:num_ready_reqs])
   220	        self.grammar_queue = self.grammar_queue[num_ready_reqs:]

   229	    def watchdog_thread(self):
   230	        """A watch dog thread that will try to kill the server itself if one forward batch takes too long."""
   231	        self.watchdog_last_forward_ct = 0
   232	        self.watchdog_last_time = time.perf_counter()
   233	
   234	        while True:
   235	            current = time.perf_counter()
   236	            if self.cur_batch is not None:
   237	                if self.watchdog_last_forward_ct == self.forward_ct:
   238	                    if current > self.watchdog_last_time + self.watchdog_timeout:
   239	                        break
   240	                else:
   241	                    self.watchdog_last_forward_ct = self.forward_ct
   242	                    self.watchdog_last_time = current
   243	            time.sleep(self.watchdog_timeout // 2)
   244	
   245	        if not disable_request_logging():
   246	            # Print batch size and memory pool info to check whether there are de-sync issues.
   247	            logger.error(
   248	                f"{self.cur_batch.batch_size()=}, "
   249	                f"{self.cur_batch.reqs=}, "
   250	                f"{self.token_to_kv_pool_allocator.available_size()=}, "
   251	                f"{self.tree_cache.evictable_size()=}, "
   252	            )
   253	
   254	        pyspy_dump_schedulers()
   255	        logger.error(f"Watchdog timeout ({self.watchdog_timeout=})")
   256	        print(file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
   257	        print(file=sys.stdout, flush=True)
   258	
   259	        # Wait for some time so that the parent process can print the error.
   260	        time.sleep(5)
   261	        self.parent_process.send_signal(signal.SIGQUIT)

   412	    def abort_request(self, recv_req: AbortReq):
   413	        # Delete requests in the waiting queue
   414	        to_del = []
   415	        for i, req in enumerate(self.waiting_queue):
   416	            if req.rid.startswith(recv_req.rid):
   417	                to_del.append(i)
   418	
   419	        # Sort in reverse order to avoid index issues when deleting
   420	        for i in reversed(to_del):
   421	            # Abort method 1: directly pop from the queue
   422	            # This only works for requests that have not started anything.
   423	            # We still need to send something back to TokenizerManager to clean up the state.
   424	            req = self.waiting_queue.pop(i)
   425	            self.send_to_tokenizer.send_pyobj(AbortReq(req.rid))
   426	            logger.debug(f"Abort queued request. {req.rid=}")
   427	
   428	        # Delete the requests in the grammar queue
   429	        for req in self.grammar_queue:
   430	            # Abort method 2: call `set_finish_with_abort`
   431	            # The request will still run one prefill forward pass.
   432	            # In this case, we change the input_ids to be only one token to make this prefill cheap.
   433	            if req.rid.startswith(recv_req.rid):
   434	                logger.debug(f"Abort grammar queue request. {req.rid=}")
   435	                if req.grammar:
   436	                    req.grammar.cancel()
   437	                req.set_finish_with_abort("Aborted by AbortReq.")
   438	
   439	        # Delete requests in the running batch
   440	        if self.cur_batch is self.running_batch or self.cur_batch is None:
   441	            reqs = self.running_batch.reqs
   442	        else:
   443	            reqs = self.running_batch.reqs + self.cur_batch.reqs
   444	
   445	        for req in reqs:
   446	            if req.rid.startswith(recv_req.rid) and not req.finished():
   447	                # Abort method 3: set `to_abort=True`
   448	                # The request will still run one decode forward pass.
   449	                # Then we reuse all existing code to clean up the KV cache allocation.
   450	                logger.debug(f"Abort running request. {req.rid=}")
   451	                req.to_abort = True

   744	    def _profile_batch_predicate(self, batch):
   745	        if self.profile_by_stage:
   746	            if batch.forward_mode.is_prefill():
   747	                if self.profiler_prefill_ct == 0:
   748	                    self.start_profile(batch.forward_mode)
   749	                self.profiler_prefill_ct += 1
   750	                if self.profiler_prefill_ct > self.profiler_target_prefill_ct:
   751	                    if self.profile_in_progress:
   752	                        self.stop_profile(stage=ForwardMode.EXTEND)
   753	            elif batch.forward_mode.is_decode():
   754	                if self.profiler_decode_ct == 0:
   755	                    if self.profile_in_progress:
   756	                        # force trace flush
   757	                        self.stop_profile(ForwardMode.EXTEND)
   758	                    self.start_profile(batch.forward_mode)
   759	                self.profiler_decode_ct += 1
   760	                if self.profiler_decode_ct > self.profiler_target_decode_ct:
   761	                    if self.profile_in_progress:
   762	                        self.stop_profile(stage=ForwardMode.DECODE)
   763	            elif batch.forward_mode.is_idle():
   764	                pass
   765	            else:
   766	                raise RuntimeError(f"unsupported profile stage: {batch.forward_mode}")
   767	        else:
   768	            # Check profiler
   769	            if (
   770	                self.profiler_target_forward_ct
   771	                and self.profiler_target_forward_ct <= self.forward_ct
   772	            ):
   773	                self.stop_profile()

    37	    def prepare_mlp_sync_batch_raw(
    38	        local_batch: ScheduleBatch,
    39	        dp_size,
    40	        attn_tp_size: int,
    41	        tp_cpu_group,
    42	        get_idle_batch,
    43	        disable_cuda_graph: bool,
    44	        spec_algorithm,
    45	        speculative_num_draft_tokens,
    46	        enable_two_batch_overlap: bool,
    47	        enable_deepep_moe: bool,
    48	        deepep_mode: DeepEPMode,
    49	        require_mlp_tp_gather: bool,
    50	    ):
    51	        # Check if other DP workers have running batches
    52	        if local_batch is None:
    53	            num_tokens = 0
    54	            num_tokens_for_logprob = 0
    55	        elif local_batch.forward_mode.is_decode():
    56	            num_tokens = local_batch.batch_size()
    57	            num_tokens_for_logprob = num_tokens
    58	        else:
    59	            num_tokens = local_batch.extend_num_tokens
    60	            num_tokens_for_logprob = sum(
    61	                [
    62	                    # We should have at least 1 token for sample in every case.
    63	                    max(extend_len - logprob_start_len, 1)
    64	                    for logprob_start_len, extend_len in zip(
    65	                        local_batch.extend_logprob_start_lens, local_batch.extend_lens
    66	                    )
    67	                ]
    68	            )
    69	
    70	        if local_batch is None or local_batch.forward_mode.is_decode_or_idle():
    71	            can_cuda_graph = 1
    72	        else:
    73	            can_cuda_graph = 0
    74	
    75	        if not spec_algorithm.is_none():
    76	            # TODO(sang): Support cuda graph when idle batch is there.
    77	            if local_batch is None or local_batch.forward_mode.is_idle():
    78	                can_cuda_graph = 0
    79	
    80	        is_extend_in_batch = (
    81	            local_batch.forward_mode.is_extend() if local_batch else False
    82	        )
    83	
    84	        tbo_preparer = TboDPAttentionPreparer()
    85	
    86	        local_info = torch.tensor(
    87	            [
    88	                num_tokens,
    89	                can_cuda_graph,
    90	                num_tokens_for_logprob,
    91	                is_extend_in_batch,
    92	                *tbo_preparer.prepare_all_gather(
    93	                    local_batch,
    94	                    deepep_mode,
    95	                    enable_deepep_moe,
    96	                    enable_two_batch_overlap,
    97	                ),
    98	            ],
    99	            dtype=torch.int64,
   100	        )
   101	        global_info = torch.empty(
   102	            (dp_size, attn_tp_size, 6),
   103	            dtype=torch.int64,
   104	        )

   106	            global_info.flatten(),
   107	            local_info,
   108	            group=tp_cpu_group,
   109	        )
   110	        global_num_tokens = global_info[:, 0, 0].tolist()
   111	        can_cuda_graph = min(global_info[:, 0, 1].tolist())
   112	        global_num_tokens_for_logprob = global_info[:, 0, 2].tolist()
   113	        is_extend_in_batch = global_info[:, 0, 3].tolist()
   114	
   115	        tbo_split_seq_index, global_forward_mode = tbo_preparer.compute_output(
   116	            global_info[:, :, 4:6]
   117	        )
   118	
   119	        if local_batch is None and max(global_num_tokens) > 0:
   120	            local_batch = get_idle_batch()

   122	        if local_batch is not None:

   124	            if not require_mlp_tp_gather:

   130	                    global_num_tokens_for_logprob
   131	                )
   132	            local_batch.is_extend_in_batch = any(is_extend_in_batch)

   157	    def move_ready_grammar_requests(self):
   158	        """Move requests whose grammar objects are ready from grammar_queue to waiting_queue."""
   159	
   160	        num_ready_reqs = 0
   161	        num_timeout_reqs = 0
   162	        for req in self.grammar_queue:
   163	            try:
   164	                if req.finished():  # It is aborted by AbortReq
   165	                    num_ready_reqs += 1
   166	                    continue
   167	                req.grammar = req.grammar.result(timeout=0.03)
   168	                self.grammar_backend.set_cache(req.grammar_key, req.grammar.copy())
   169	                if req.grammar is INVALID_GRAMMAR_OBJ:
   170	                    req.set_finish_with_abort(
   171	                        f"Invalid grammar request: {req.grammar_key=}"
   172	                    )
   173	                num_ready_reqs += 1
   174	            except futures._base.TimeoutError:
   175	                req.grammar_wait_ct += 1
   176	                # NOTE(lianmin): this timeout is the waiting time of the above line. It is
   177	                # not the waiting time from it enters the grammar queue.
   178	                if req.grammar_wait_ct > GRAMMAR_TIMEOUT / 0.03:
   179	                    num_timeout_reqs = 1
   180	                break
   181	
   182	        if self.server_args.enable_dp_attention:
   183	            tp_size = self.attn_tp_size
   184	            tp_group = self.attn_tp_cpu_group
   185	        else:
   186	            tp_size = self.tp_size
   187	            tp_group = self.tp_cpu_group
   188	
   189	        if tp_size > 1:
   190	            # Sync across TP ranks to make sure they have the same number of ready requests
   191	            tensor = torch.tensor([num_ready_reqs, num_timeout_reqs], dtype=torch.int32)
   192	            torch.distributed.all_reduce(
   193	                tensor, op=torch.distributed.ReduceOp.MAX, group=tp_group
   194	            )
   195	            num_ready_reqs_max, num_timeout_reqs_max = tensor.tolist()
   196	
   197	            for i in range(num_ready_reqs, num_ready_reqs_max):
   198	                req = self.grammar_queue[i]
   199	                if req.finished():  # It is aborted by AbortReq
   200	                    continue
   201	                req.grammar = req.grammar.result()
   202	                self.grammar_backend.set_cache(req.grammar_key, req.grammar.copy())
   203	                if req.grammar is INVALID_GRAMMAR_OBJ:
   204	                    req.set_finish_with_abort(
   205	                        f"Invalid grammar request: {req.grammar_key=}"
   206	                    )
   207	        else:
   208	            num_ready_reqs_max = num_ready_reqs
   209	            num_timeout_reqs_max = num_timeout_reqs
   210	
   211	        for i in range(num_ready_reqs, num_ready_reqs + num_timeout_reqs_max):
   212	            req = self.grammar_queue[i]
   213	            req.grammar.cancel()
   214	            error_msg = f"Grammar preprocessing timed out for {req.grammar_key=}"
   215	            req.set_finish_with_abort(error_msg)
   216	            self.grammar_backend.set_cache(req.grammar_key, INVALID_GRAMMAR_OBJ)
   217	        num_ready_reqs = num_ready_reqs_max + num_timeout_reqs_max
   218	
   219	        self._extend_requests_to_queue(self.grammar_queue[:num_ready_reqs])
   220	        self.grammar_queue = self.grammar_queue[num_ready_reqs:]

   229	    def watchdog_thread(self):
   230	        """A watch dog thread that will try to kill the server itself if one forward batch takes too long."""
   231	        self.watchdog_last_forward_ct = 0
   232	        self.watchdog_last_time = time.perf_counter()
   233	
   234	        while True:
   235	            current = time.perf_counter()
   236	            if self.cur_batch is not None:
   237	                if self.watchdog_last_forward_ct == self.forward_ct:
   238	                    if current > self.watchdog_last_time + self.watchdog_timeout:
   239	                        break
   240	                else:
   241	                    self.watchdog_last_forward_ct = self.forward_ct
   242	                    self.watchdog_last_time = current
   243	            time.sleep(self.watchdog_timeout // 2)
   244	
   245	        if not disable_request_logging():
   246	            # Print batch size and memory pool info to check whether there are de-sync issues.
   247	            logger.error(
   248	                f"{self.cur_batch.batch_size()=}, "
   249	                f"{self.cur_batch.reqs=}, "
   250	                f"{self.token_to_kv_pool_allocator.available_size()=}, "
   251	                f"{self.tree_cache.evictable_size()=}, "
   252	            )
   253	
   254	        pyspy_dump_schedulers()
   255	        logger.error(f"Watchdog timeout ({self.watchdog_timeout=})")
   256	        print(file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
   257	        print(file=sys.stdout, flush=True)
   258	
   259	        # Wait for some time so that the parent process can print the error.
   260	        time.sleep(5)
   261	        self.parent_process.send_signal(signal.SIGQUIT)

   267	    def flush_cache(self):
   268	        """Flush the memory pool and cache."""
   269	        if (
   270	            len(self.waiting_queue) == 0
   271	            and self.running_batch.is_empty()
   272	            and (self.pp_size == 1 or all(x.is_empty() for x in self.running_mbs))
   273	        ):
   274	            self.cur_batch = None
   275	            self.last_batch = None
   276	            self.tree_cache.reset()
   277	            if self.grammar_backend:
   278	                self.grammar_backend.reset()
   279	            self.req_to_token_pool.clear()
   280	            self.token_to_kv_pool_allocator.clear()
   281	
   282	            if not self.spec_algorithm.is_none():
   283	                self.draft_worker.model_runner.req_to_token_pool.clear()
   284	                self.draft_worker.model_runner.token_to_kv_pool_allocator.clear()
   285	
   286	            self.num_generated_tokens = 0
   287	            self.forward_ct_decode = 0
   288	            self.spec_num_total_accepted_tokens = 0
   289	            self.spec_num_total_forward_ct = 0
   290	            self.cum_spec_accept_length = 0
   291	            self.cum_spec_accept_count = 0
   292	            torch.cuda.empty_cache()
   293	            logger.info("Cache flushed successfully!")
   294	            if_success = True
   295	        else:
   296	            logging.warning(
   297	                f"Cache not flushed because there are pending requests. "
   298	                f"#queue-req: {len(self.waiting_queue)}, "
   299	                f"#running-req: {len(self.running_batch.reqs)}"
   300	            )
   301	            if_success = False
   302	        return if_success

   412	    def abort_request(self, recv_req: AbortReq):
   413	        # Delete requests in the waiting queue
   414	        to_del = []
   415	        for i, req in enumerate(self.waiting_queue):
   416	            if req.rid.startswith(recv_req.rid):
   417	                to_del.append(i)
   418	
   419	        # Sort in reverse order to avoid index issues when deleting
   420	        for i in reversed(to_del):
   421	            # Abort method 1: directly pop from the queue
   422	            # This only works for requests that have not started anything.
   423	            # We still need to send something back to TokenizerManager to clean up the state.
   424	            req = self.waiting_queue.pop(i)
   425	            self.send_to_tokenizer.send_pyobj(AbortReq(req.rid))
   426	            logger.debug(f"Abort queued request. {req.rid=}")
   427	
   428	        # Delete the requests in the grammar queue
   429	        for req in self.grammar_queue:
   430	            # Abort method 2: call `set_finish_with_abort`
   431	            # The request will still run one prefill forward pass.
   432	            # In this case, we change the input_ids to be only one token to make this prefill cheap.
   433	            if req.rid.startswith(recv_req.rid):
   434	                logger.debug(f"Abort grammar queue request. {req.rid=}")
   435	                if req.grammar:
   436	                    req.grammar.cancel()
   437	                req.set_finish_with_abort("Aborted by AbortReq.")
   438	
   439	        # Delete requests in the running batch
   440	        if self.cur_batch is self.running_batch or self.cur_batch is None:
   441	            reqs = self.running_batch.reqs
   442	        else:
   443	            reqs = self.running_batch.reqs + self.cur_batch.reqs
   444	
   445	        for req in reqs:
   446	            if req.rid.startswith(recv_req.rid) and not req.finished():
   447	                # Abort method 3: set `to_abort=True`
   448	                # The request will still run one decode forward pass.
   449	                # Then we reuse all existing code to clean up the KV cache allocation.
   450	                logger.debug(f"Abort running request. {req.rid=}")
   451	                req.to_abort = True
